scope: Development acceptance, not a provider or platform-wide performance guarantee

startup.method: Nine fresh Node processes per build, warm OS disk cache, median; mocked Obsidian imports. Excludes Obsidian activation, document parsing and first speech.

desktopLiveActivation.scope: Observed onload during a real plugin reload; excludes module evaluation and complete app startup; no before/after activation baseline

startup.change: Load PDF bookmark-writing dependency only when writing bookmarks; temporary-file cleanup no longer blocks UI registration, but playback waits for cleanup before creating files.
startup.decision: Optimize the existing plugin before creating a separate lite edition. No evidence here that splitting products would materially improve perceived startup. Mobile is already substantially smaller.

liveProvider.textSource: Two invented English public samples, no vault content
liveProvider.limitation: Electron aborted muted background media to save power, also reproduced using a generated silent WAV. Network and decoding succeeded; no measured speaker startup, continuous gap or real jump-speed claim. No more requests were made after the six-request cap.

automaticChecks: no raw transcript or credential records

pdf: same synthetic corpus on desktop and mobile
existing cross-page, footnote and highlight/follow suites
mobile: system speech remains paused while hidden
unsupported Media Session handlers degrade safely

remainingAcceptance: Physical iPhone/iPad lock-screen and background continuation
Real speaker startup/gaps and jump timings in a foreground interactive session

privacy: No personal documents or credentials are included in this report or the fixtures. No publishing was performed during this acceptance run.
